summary: Hange reaches Levi, who is still breathing after the forest. Around that breath, the people under the red sky argue what pride is worth if the march does not stop.

segments.ja: ハンジは、森のあとでリヴァイを見つけます。見つける体は、立っていません。立っていないまま、息だけが続いています。続いている息を、彼女は団の残りとして扱います。扱う手は、治療の手順を今日の話にはしません。しません。置くのは、最強と呼ばれた人が、まだ名前で呼べる、です。呼べる事実が、夕焼けの輪をこの場所へ寄せます。寄せた輪は、まだ決定の輪ではありません。
segments.en: After the forest, Hange finds Levi. The body she finds is not standing. Without standing, only the breath is continuing. She treats the breath that is continuing as what remains of the corps. Her hands do not turn a treatment into today's story as a procedure. They do not. What she sets down is that the person once called the strongest can still be called by name. The fact of being able to call him draws the sunset circle to this place. The circle it draws is not yet a circle of decision.

segments.en: The Survey Corps' pride was once the mark of the wings. It was. Today's mark is cloth set beside a captain who cannot move. Jean looks at the cloth that was set, at the place of his own chest. There is no order in the place he looks. In place of the order that is not there, there is the sound of breath. Armin makes the sound that is there into proof that a person for conversation is still alive. The proof he makes is small. The small proof is the floor of this gathering. On that floor, the cloth of the wings is quieter than an order.

segments.ja: ジークの名は、この床にはありません。ない名は、エレンと接触したまま列の上にいる、と繰り返されます。繰り返す報告を、リヴァイは目だけで受けます。受ける目は、森で止めたはずの相手がまだ歩いている、です。歩いている相手を、ハンジは今は追いません。追わない理由は、息を切ったら矜持も切れる、です。切らない選択が、隊長をこの場に残します。残した選択が、今夜の矜持の形です。
segments.en: Zeke's name is not on this floor. The name that is not there is repeated as still above the row, in contact with Eren. Levi receives the report that is repeated with his eyes only. The eyes that receive it say the opponent he should have stopped in the forest is still walking. Hange does not chase the opponent who is walking now. The reason she does not chase is that if the breath is cut, the pride is cut too. The choice of not cutting leaves the captain in this place. The choice that was left is the shape of tonight's pride.

segments.titleEn: Annie sets down the years of sleep
segments.ja: アニは、結晶の年数を自慢にしません。しません。置くのは、眠っているあいだに世界の形が変わった、です。変わった形を、彼女はリヴァイの息の横で見ます。見る相手は、かつて自分を追い詰めた人です。人を、今日は敵の席だけでは呼びません。呼ばない理由は、行進が個人の勝負より大きい、です。大きい事実の前で、彼女の声は低くなります。
segments.en: Annie does not make the years of the crystal into a boast. She does not. What she sets down is that the shape of the world changed while she slept. She looks at the shape that changed beside Levi's breath. The person she looks at is the person who once cornered her. She does not call that person today only by the seat of an enemy. The reason she does not call him that is that the march is larger than a personal match. In front of the large fact, her voice goes low.

segments.ja: ファルコとガビは、大人の矜持の話を端で聞きます。聞く話は、自分たちが候補として教わった正しさとは違います。違う点は、勝つことが一番ではない、です。ではない言葉を、ガビはすぐには信じません。信じない隣で、ファルコはリヴァイの息を見ます。見る息は、英雄の絵ではありません。ではありません。まだ死なない、という細い事実です。事実のほうが、演説より先に二人の耳に残ります。
segments.en: Falco and Gabi listen at the edge to the adults' talk of pride. The talk they listen to differs from the rightness they were taught as candidates. The point that differs is that winning is not the first thing. Gabi does not believe the words that are not that, at once. Beside the not believing, Falco looks at Levi's breath. The breath he looks at is not a picture of a hero. It is not. It is the thin fact of not dying yet. The fact remains in the two people's ears ahead of a speech.

segments.ja: イェレナは、行進そのものを島の矜持だと言います。言う矜持は、世界に踏まれる前に踏む、です。踏む計画を、彼女はリヴァイの息の前でも下げません。下げない笑顔を、ハンジは信用しません。信用しない理由は、その笑顔が息の数を見ていない、です。見ていない成功を、アルミンは会話では割れません。割れない夜が、二つの矜持を同じ床に置きます。置いた床は、どちらの勝ちも宣言しません。
segments.en: Yelena says the march itself is the island's pride. The pride she says is to trample before being trampled by the world. She does not lower the plan of trampling even in front of Levi's breath. Hange does not trust the smile that does not lower it. The reason she does not trust it is that the smile is not looking at the count of breaths. Armin cannot split the success it is not looking at, with a conversation. The night that cannot split it sets two prides on the same floor. The floor it sets does not declare either victory.

tokens.note: A Marley volunteer who comes to the island with Zeke's plan and treats the Survey Corps as allies.

segments.ja: フロックの矜持は、この床には座っていません。座っていない矜持は、エレンに従うことが島を守る唯一の形だ、です。だ、を、追う兵が外で配っています。配っている噂が、この集まりを裏切りの席にします。席にされた人々は、まだ旗を一つにしていません。していないまま、彼らは息の音を優先します。優先する選択を、外の矜持は弱さと呼びます。呼ぶ声は、まだ扉を開けていません。
segments.en: Floch's pride is not sitting on this floor. The pride that is not sitting is that following Eren is the only shape that protects the island. The soldiers who chase are distributing that outside. The rumor they are distributing makes this gathering into a seat of betrayal. The people made into that seat have not yet made the flags one. Without having made them one, they give priority to the sound of breath. The pride outside calls the choice of giving priority weakness. The voice that calls it has not opened the door yet.

segments.en: During the talk of pride, Mikasa does not receive the word target. The position of not receiving it is the edge of the circle. A face without a signature guards the edge of the floor.

Armin makes the sound that is there into proof that a person for conversation is still alive. The proof he makes is small. The small proof is the floor of this gathering. On that floor, the cloth of the wings is quieter than an order.

The choice that was left is the shape of tonight's pride.

The night that cannot split it sets two prides on the same floor. The floor it sets does not declare either victory.

The breath he looks at is not a picture of a hero. It is not. It is the thin fact of not dying yet. The fact remains in the two people's ears ahead of a speech.

vocab.exampleEn: Zeke's name is not on this floor. The name that is not there is repeated as still above the row, in contact with Eren. Levi receives the report that is repeated with his eyes only. The eyes that receive it say the opponent he should have stopped in the forest is still walking. Hange does not chase the opponent who is walking now. The reason she does not chase is that if the breath is cut, the pride is cut too. The choice of not cutting leaves the captain in this place. The choice that was left is the shape of tonight's pride.
